messages:
Lina (PM): quick thought: to avoid ad-hoc "asks" we should publish a compliance triage rubric and run a small pilot to pick customers for BYOK/extended-retention/SOC2 prep. idea is a clear, reproducible rule set.
Dev (Infra Eng): sounds good. what's the rubric look like?
Lina (PM): three axes: compliance-critical (regulatory flags, legal holds), revenue-impact (ARR, upsell potential), and infra-cost-risk (token volume, spikeiness). score each 0-10, weighted sum -> heat category (low/med/high).
Omar (Security): include a fourth gating check: data residency + export restrictions. if customer fails gating we route to legal review instead of pilot.
Priya (Sales Eng): can we bias revenue-impact x1.5 for named strategic targets? sales will feed those in.
Nora (Legal): legal ok with weighting as long as exceptions are auditable and we keep a record of decisions. need a standard addendum template for any retention change.
Lina (PM): proposal for pilot: pick top 10 high-heat tenants; 6 get BYOK pilot, 4 get extended retention only. timeline: spike (2 weeks) -> internal dry-run (1 week) -> customer pilots (6 weeks).
Dev (Infra Eng): engineering asks: define acceptance criteria. I propose: per-tenant retention config (7/30/90/180/365), synchronous hooks for audit export with at-least-once delivery for 30 days, no >5% p99 latency regression on generation endpoints.
Omar (Security): BYOK acceptance: KMS integration with HSM-backed keys, documented attestation flow, key rotation policy, and no-key-escrow option for pilot. threat-model doc required.
Priya (Sales Eng): customers asked for quick opt-in path. can we fast-track 2 customers with extended retention + premium support while BYOK follows?
Lina (PM): yes fast-track plan: extended retention + concierge onboarding, BYOK deferred. will document tradeoffs.
Nora (Legal): will draft short retention addendum and a checklist of regulatory items (GDPR DSR, FINREG flags, legal holds).
Dev (Infra Eng): rough effort: core retention toggle + export plumbing -> 2 sprints, per-tenant key handshake + KMS adapters -> 3 sprints, telemetry & dashboards -> 1 sprint. onboard support spread across sprint cycles.
Lina (PM): need oncall + playbook: escalation path, who owns incident for audit exports, rollback criteria if export backlog grows >5% of traffic, communication templates for customers.
Omar (Security): add a compliance owner field in tenant metadata and last-audit-date. security will review playbook.
Priya (Sales Eng): i'll provide candidate list with contract terms and ability-to-pay notes by Monday.
Lina (PM): dashboard idea: per-tenant heat score, contributing factors, recommended action (BYOK / Retention365 / SOC2 prep), last decision and decision-actor.
Dev (Infra Eng): +1. also instrument expected perf delta so PM and Eng can see tradeoffs.
Lina (PM): small config example we'll test with customers:
Lina (PM): ```json
{
  "tenant": "vertex-ai-inc",
  "retention_days": 365,
  "audit_export": {"enabled": true, "dest": "s3://acme-evidence"},
  "byok": {"requested": true, "kms_provider": "aws-kms", "hsm_required": true}
}
```
Dev (Infra Eng): will use that for the spike to validate export semantics.
Nora (Legal): note: if a customer requests extended retention >365 we need commercial approval and a data minimization review.
Priya (Sales Eng): customers in APAC asking about local evidence exports. flagging now.
Omar (Security): for APAC/regional exports add extra review: encrypted-at-rest AND in-transit per region law.
jobs-bot: meeting scheduled: Compliance Triage Pilot sync on 2024-10-07 15:00 UTC (invite sent)
Lina (PM): next steps: 1) Priya uploads candidate list (Mon), 2) Nora drafts addendum + checklist (EOW), 3) Dev does spike (2w), 4) Omar reviews threat model (after spike), 5) sync 10/7 to finalize pilot roster.
Priya (Sales Eng): noted, will upload and mark customers who need local data handling.
Dev (Infra Eng): will include perf baseline and test harness for export delivery.
Lina (PM): keeping this compact. if anyone wants to add rubric inputs (legal holds, past incidents, audit frequency) say it here. otherwise i'll author the short PRD and rubric spreadsheet after Priya's list.
